item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul
item.coloph: gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung bstan/ stong chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis snyan brgyud/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i dngos grub/ rjes 'jug las can bu yi skol byang / phyi rabs sgrub pa po yi spyod yul/ dam can srung ma rnams kyi phrin las rdzogs so// u ya ithaM// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//

item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho dbyings nas thugs dam rgyud bskul
item.coloph: gyer spungs dran pa nam mkha'i lung don/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi snyan rgyud/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i dngos grub/ rjes 'jug las can skyes bu'i bkol byang / phyi rab (rabs) sgrub pa'i spyod yul du/ dam can srung ma rnams kyi 'phrin las rdzogs so//
